evidence.title: G-CARL: Grounded Checklist-Aligned Reward Learning for Patient-Oriented Medical Report Interpretation

summary: Researchers introduced G‑CARL, a grounded checklist‑aligned reward learning framework designed to enhance AI interpretation of medical reports for patient use. Benchmarks demonstrate that G‑CARL outperforms prior systems in accuracy and clinical relevance while adhering to established medical checklists.
title: New AI model G‑CARL boosts patient‑oriented medical report interpretation with checklist‑aligned reward learning
